The *Upādinnattika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 17.23) is a canonical Abhidhamma text situated within the *Paṭṭhāna* collection [SuttaCentral]. As designated by its title, the work systematically examines the intersection of the triad concerning clinging/attached phenomena (*upādinnattika*) and the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states (*kusalattika*) according to the analytical conditioning relations of the *Paṭṭhāna* system [SuttaCentral].

No external parallels in Chinese, Tibetan, or Sanskrit have been documented, and DharmaNexus records no cross-language matches meeting the threshold [DharmaNexus]. However, DharmaNexus detects extensive internal text reuse across the Pali Abhidhamma corpus, identifying 121 matching passages shared among 38 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus].
